_about: Jean Lyttleton McKechnie, American author, for the Word Hoard. Added 2026-11-15 by the non-renewal sweep, batch 10 (Adam 2026-11-03: "I want everything that was not renewed"): the Gutenberg texts of Jean Lyttleton McKechnie's 1931-1963 books that were never renewed, each checked in NYPL's cce-renewals. No uids minted. She wrote the Jean Craig books as 'Kay Lyttleton' (Gutenberg's catalogue gives her middle name, Lyttleton) and Penny Allen under her own name.
